aurora_roster.verdict: No October 2026 roster change is visible on either source. Both list the same five starters plus coach ash. The premise of a recent (October) Aurora roster change is NOT supported by the sources read in this session; the visible rebuild is older (the roster has been together since the July 2026 window reported by earlier sessions).

context: Aurora beat FURIA 2-1 on 6 Oct 2026, per bo3.gg's Aurora match list (ESL Pro League S24).
Aurora won four of their last five series before this match, including a 2-0 over Spirit (11 Oct) and a 2-0 over 9z in the day-3 decider (16 Oct).
FURIA were idle on 16 Oct; Aurora played the decider on 16 Oct. Rest favours FURIA, form favours Aurora.
Rosters are unchanged in October on both HLTV and bo3.gg, so the day-1 upset is not explained by a roster change.
BETBOOM are 27% - below the 35% no-lottery floor, so there is no qualified climb pick here.
BETBOOM played (and won) the day-3 decider; Falcons had 16 Oct off.

unresolved_policy: A row with no usable price and no uniquely identified rating pair is published as unresolved: pick blank, reason listed, retried by the 4-hourly collector. A lower bound ('>= x%') is published only when exactly one side is rated and the other is absent from Valve's published list; the bound uses the opponent at the list floor and is labelled as a bound, never as a point estimate.

read_window.note: All external pages in reads[] were fetched by this session between these two clocks. A single batch timestamp is used for every row rather than invented per-request seconds; each entry is therefore 'read no later than to_utc'.
